messages:
emma: quick heads-up — link-scan found ~18 broken anchors across runtime-guide and onboarding. can owners claim small fixes? attaching sample: /runtime/api#batching -> should be /runtime/optimizations#batching

docs-bot: automated link-scan report: 18 items, severity: low-medium. report: http://internal-tools/reports/9401234567 

oliver: I own runtime-guide. I can take the top 6 anchors. will open a branch later today. :+1:

raj: if you want a tiny sed to fix anchors in bulk, try this locally first:
```bash
rg "runtime/api#" -l docs/ | xargs -n1 -I{} sed -i "s/runtime\/api#batching/runtime\/optimizations#batching/g" {}
```

louise: heads-up that some of those pages are included in the onboarding build, so please add a staging preview link in the PR so QA can sanity-check rendering.

maya: pinging @oliver for CR when you have the branch. I can do quick review during lunch. also can re-run the link-scan job after fixes — saves a follow-up round.

oliver: nice, will do. plan:
- create branch docs/rg-anchor-fix
- apply sed for the 6 anchors I own
- push + open PR with staging preview 

oliver: opening PR now: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4218 — minor sed changes, added a few small copy tweaks. staging preview at https://staging.redwood.internal/preview/4218

louise: quick browse looks good. found one remaining odd anchor on onboarding/setup.md (line ~42) — tagging in PR comment.

raj: also left a tiny note in the PR about escaping `#` in a few links in markdown renderers (some parsers treat it as fragment). not a blocker.

oliver: addressed louise and raj comments, pushed a follow-up commit.

maya: leaving a short CR now. can merge after my 👍 and CI passes. I will run the link-scan job (9401234567) after merge and post results.

emma: thank you all — appreciate the quick pickup. will mark remaining items and reassign owners for next sweep. :coffee:
